title: U.S. House · Florida's 20th District
area: Parts of Broward County, including Weston and surrounding South Florida communities, under Florida's 2026 congressional map.

context.text: Florida's U.S. House elections use a new congressional map for 2026; Gov. Ron DeSantis signed the new district boundaries into law on May 4, 2026.

Incumbent Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz (D) won the Democratic primary on August 18, 2026, defeating Luther Campbell, Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick, Dale Holness, and Elijah Manley. Brent Andersen won the Republican primary. Kedner Maxime advanced as the Independent Party of Florida nominee after that primary was canceled.

priorities.text: Says increasing access to higher education and improving college affordability have been a top priority throughout her legislative career, including continued support for robust Pell grant funding and legislation allowing students to refinance loans at low rates.

Says addressing gun violence as a public health crisis is a priority, including closing background-check loopholes, banning the sale of assault weapons and high-capacity magazines, and funding CDC research on gun violence.

Says she uses her position as a senior appropriator on the Energy and Water Appropriations Subcommittee to support a national energy strategy promoting a rapid transition to clean, renewable, domestic energy sources.

positions.summary: Says Congress should close background-check loopholes for gun and ammunition purchases and ban the sale of assault weapons and high-capacity magazines.
positions.quote: We should start by closing all the background check loopholes that allow dangerous people to evade the law and purchase deadly firearms.

positions.summary: Says efforts to repeal or defund the Affordable Care Act are not productive and cites its coverage and subsidy gains for Floridians.
positions.quote: efforts to repeal or defund the ACA are not productive in working toward quality, more affordable healthcare for all Americans.

positions.summary: Says she is committed to a pathway to citizenship and protections for DREAMers, Temporary Protected Status holders, and refugees, and has sponsored or cosponsored bills to protect DACA and TPS recipients.
positions.quote: This includes providing a pathway to citizenship, fair treatment under the law, and extending protections for DREAMers, Temporary Protected Status holders, and refugees.

positions.summary: Says she supports a national energy strategy for a rapid transition to clean, renewable energy sources to address the climate crisis, while opposing offshore oil and gas drilling.
positions.quote: I believe it is critical that we use smart, forward-thinking energy policy to address the climate crisis and prevent the worst consequences of climate change by dramatically reducing our emissions of greenhouse gases.

positions.summary: Says she will defend the right to abortion services.
positions.quote: I will always defend this right, including access to abortion services, for women here at home and around the world as a principle tenet of women’s comprehensive health.

positions.summary: Says she cosponsored legislation to raise the federal minimum wage and tipped minimum wage to $15.
positions.quote: I have cosponsored legislation to raise the federal minimum wage and tipped minimum wage to 15 dollars by 2020.

record.text: Sits on the House Appropriations Committee for the 2025–2026 Congress, including its Agriculture and Energy and Water subcommittees.
Authored the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act, enacted in 2007, and sponsored the PROTECT Our Children Act, creating a federal law enforcement effort to protect children.
Introduced the EARLY Act to increase breast cancer education and awareness, which was enacted as part of the Affordable Care Act in 2010.
Introduced the Rape Survivor Child Custody Act, encouraging states to allow termination of a rapist's parental rights; signed into law in 2015.

candidates.name: Brent Andersen

priorities.text: Says his experience in the insurance industry drives his focus on market-based solutions to lower property insurance premiums and housing costs.
Says he will bring private-sector experience and fiscal responsibility to Congress to grow jobs and economic opportunity.
Says he will defend limited government, the Second Amendment, secure borders, and parental rights.

positions.summary: Said in an Aug. 2026 interview that he is firmly pro-life.

statements.quote: Sí, apoyo la Segunda Enmienda. No se puede cambiar la Constitución sin una enmienda constitucional. Ahora bien, si hubiera restricciones razonables para que la gente mala no tenga armas, sí, por supuesto.
statements.context: Spanish-language interview with Diario las Américas, Aug. 2, 2026
